mapper.select: SELECT c.cartId AS id, CAST(c.userId AS UNSIGNED) AS user_id, c.businessId AS merchant_id, c.foodId AS food_id, f.foodName AS food_name, f.foodPrice AS food_price, f.foodImg AS food_image_url, c.quantity AS quantity, 1 AS checked FROM cart c JOIN food f ON f.foodId = c.foodId WHERE c.userId = CAST(#{userId} AS CHAR) AND c.businessId = #{merchantId} ORDER BY c.cartId ASC

SELECT c.cartId AS id, CAST(c.userId AS UNSIGNED) AS user_id, c.businessId AS merchant_id, c.foodId AS food_id, f.foodName AS food_name, f.foodPrice AS food_price, f.foodImg AS food_image_url, c.quantity AS quantity, 1 AS checked FROM cart c JOIN food f ON f.foodId = c.foodId WHERE c.userId = CAST(#{userId} AS CHAR) AND c.businessId = #{merchantId} AND c.foodId = #{foodId} LIMIT 1

SELECT c.cartId AS id, CAST(c.userId AS UNSIGNED) AS user_id, c.businessId AS merchant_id, c.foodId AS food_id, f.foodName AS food_name, f.foodPrice AS food_price, f.foodImg AS food_image_url, c.quantity AS quantity, 1 AS checked FROM cart c JOIN food f ON f.foodId = c.foodId WHERE c.cartId = #{itemId} AND c.userId = CAST(#{userId} AS CHAR) LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (foodId, businessId, userId, quantity) VALUES (#{foodId}, #{merchantId}, CAST(#{userId} AS CHAR), #{quantity})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart WHERE cartId = #{itemId} AND userId = CAST(#{userId} AS CHAR)
